scope: Explicit user request: evaluate comparable published methods. Pending adapter/bundle states are not running jobs or measured results.

methods.name: Life-Harness
methods.reason_zh: 五场景公开内置产物三遍完成；四场景保留有效历史记录，WebShop为新测。仍未认证为论文最终进化包。
methods.reason_en: Three repeats complete on all five benchmarks: four retained valid measurements and new WebShop measurements. Not certified as paper-final bundles.

methods.name: ALIGN
methods.reason_zh: 公开ReAct接口在共同工具调用环境完成ALFWorld109题×3、WebShop200题×3；属于新适配实测。
methods.reason_en: Released ReAct interfaces measured on ALFWorld109×3 and WebShop200×3 in the shared tool-call runtime.

methods.name: AgentSquare
methods.reason_zh: 已有ALFWorld/WebShop模块代码；推荐组合涉及OpenAI嵌入检索与跨任务记忆，接入共同评测前需明确这些额外资源和测试期记忆规则。
methods.reason_en: Public modular policies exist; the recommended combination uses embedding retrieval and cross-task memory, requiring explicit resource and evaluation-memory alignment.

methods.name: Meta-Harness
methods.reason_zh: Life提供原生搜索入口，但未定位与其表格成绩绑定的最终包；从头搜索与产物复测分开排期。
methods.reason_en: Life supplies native search entrypoints; a score-bound final bundle has not been located.

methods.name: AHE
methods.reason_zh: 已有Life原生适配入口；最终产物缺失时需要实际重新搜索，不能把空Harness当论文产物。
methods.reason_en: Life supplies native adaptation. Missing final bundles require an actual new search, not empty policies.

methods.name: HarnessX
methods.reason_zh: 原结果不同模型、pass@2、同任务进化峰值；当前公开树未定位论文场景的最终产物与完整适配。
methods.reason_en: Different actors, pass@2 peaks on adaptation tasks; final benchmark bundles/adapters not located.

methods.name: SkillOpt
methods.reason_zh: 需论文对应Skill与执行Harness；已有SkillOpt风格本地实验不能冒充原作者复现。
methods.reason_en: Requires paper-matched skills and executor harness; local SkillOpt-inspired runs are not original reproductions.

methods.name: SkillFM
methods.reason_zh: 原作者明确未发布模型权重，仅提供代码、配置与训练技能库。完整复现需额外训练资源，不以检索替代生成方法。
methods.reason_en: No model weights released; complete reproduction needs codec/flow training, not a retrieval substitution.

methods.name: Reflexion
methods.reason_zh: 多次尝试与反馈是方法的一部分；必须报告first-attempt及额外尝试成本，不能冒充冻结单遍。
methods.reason_en: Repeated attempts/feedback are part of the method; separate first-attempt and additional-attempt cost.

methods.name: ReflAct
methods.reason_zh: 原论文指令与两条附录示例已接入共同ALFWorld环境；109题×3，Qwen3-4B，单题50次模型调用上限；不是原论文模型成绩。
methods.reason_en: Original instructions and two appendix demonstrations run on shared ALFWorld109×3 with Qwen3-4B and50 model calls; cross-executor prompt transfer.

methods.name: AutoManual
methods.reason_zh: 冻结原作者释放的手册、六类技能与Planner测试流程，在共同ALFWorld109题×3复测。原文WebArena不是WebShop。
methods.reason_en: Frozen released manual, six task-type skills and original planner on shared ALFWorld109×3. Original WebArena is not WebShop.

methods.name: GEPA
methods.reason_zh: 通用优化方法；本场景需原生适配与真实搜索，不直接转抄其他任务结果。
methods.reason_en: A general optimizer; these tasks require a native adapter and actual optimization.

methods.name: HarnessOpt
methods.reason_zh: 作为完整Harness搜索参照；确认共享场景与冻结权重协议后才入主榜。
methods.reason_en: Full-harness search reference; benchmark overlap and frozen-weight protocol still require verification.

methods.name: ReAct
methods.reason_zh: 与ReflAct采用相同两条任务示例与ALFWorld题单，比较Thought和Reflection策略；冻结提示，无测试反馈。
methods.reason_en: Matched two demonstrations and shared ALFWorld tasks compare thought versus reflection; frozen prompts with no test feedback.

methods.name: AdaPlanner
methods.reason_zh: 从既有方法引用链发现；已核实ALFWorld重合，下一批适配原始代码规划与反馈机制。
methods.reason_en: Discovered through prior-work references; ALFWorld overlap verified, code-planning/feedback adapter pending.

methods.name: ExpeL
methods.surface: training experience, extracted insights and retrieval
methods.reason_zh: 从AutoManual与SkillFM引用链发现；核实原作者代码覆盖ALFWorld/WebShop。需对齐训练经验、规则提取和评测时检索。
methods.reason_en: Discovered through AutoManual and SkillFM references; official code covers ALFWorld/WebShop. Training experience, insight extraction and inference retrieval need alignment.

methods.name: Harness-R1
methods.reason_zh: 已启动原作者释放补丁的DBBench共同300题三遍评测，固定Qwen3-4B；不重新训练9B编辑模型。
methods.reason_en: Released engineer patch available; DBBench shared-Qwen3-4B transfer evaluation running.

methods.name: GEPA-Curator
methods.reason_zh: 优化任务筛选与成功经验检索；原文使用gpt-oss-120b执行模型。所查原文未定位Curator专用释放代码；τ-bench不是τ²-Telecom。
methods.reason_en: Task curation and success retrieval for prompt optimization; original actor gpt-oss-120b, no directly matching Qwen3-4B artifact located.

methods.name: Verify-Backtrack Loop
methods.reason_zh: 无需训练的目标栈、双层验证与回退机制；ALFWorld重合，所查原文未定位官方代码，适配待做。
methods.reason_en: Training-free goal-stack verification and backtracking; no official code URL located in the inspected paper.

methods.name: Repairs for Whom?
methods.reason_zh: 评估器与执行器不一致的修复选择研究；用于方法讨论，不是最终Harness主榜成绩。
methods.reason_en: Repair-evaluator/executor mismatch study; cite selection methodology, not a final harness leaderboard row.
